author: reek
body: The other half of the conversation. Until now this chapter could build a CoAP request and not read a response, so a block-wise download was a device shouting into a socket.

author: reek
body: A Block2 response: 2.05 Content, block 2, more set, szx 6, with a body.

author: reek
body: An absent option is not a zero option. A response with no Block2 at all means the whole body arrived, and the parser must say so.
